descr.name: Fluorescence Polarization (FP) Assay from US Patent US20240335431: "1-H-PYRROLO[2,3-c]PYRIDINE COMPOUNDS"
description: Compounds were tested in a biochemical binding assay using Menin protein at 2 nM (N6his-tev-Menin_4i80, PB-20-1459) and the substrate cRho110-Ahx-MBM1/MBM2 peptide (UbiQ, UbiQ-Q20201030; cRh110-Ahx-SCRWRFPARPGTTGGGGGGGRRGLGGAPR-QRVPALLLPPG-NH2) at 1 nM.384 Low volume black plates (Corning #4514) were used. 5 μL/well compound or 3% DMSO was added at 10-fold serial dilutions in DMSO from 10 μM. 5 μL/well cRho110-Ahx-MBM1/MBM2 peptide or binding buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 0.01% BGG, 0.01% Brij-35) was added to all wells. 5 μL/well Menin protein or binding buffer (50 mM Tris pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 1 mM TCEP, 0.01% BGG, 0.01% Brij-35) was added to all wells. Plates were read on an EnVision plate reader (Perkin Elmer) with excitation at 480 nm and emission at 535 nm P+S, and measured every 5 minutes for 180 minutes.
comment: Compounds with any of Ki, IC50, Kd, or EC50 activity value <= 10uM are labeled as "Active".

If multiple measurements are available for a given compound, it is labeled as "Active" if any of the measurements meet the criterion. Activity values are checked in the order of Ki, IC50, Kd, and EC50. The first entry that meets the above activity threshold is used to determine "Standard Type", "Standard Relation", and "PubChem Standard Value". Otherwise, the first non-empty entry will be used to set those values.

results.name: Standard Type
description: Standardized activity type (i.e. Ki, IC50, Kd, or EC50)

results.name: PubChem Standard Value
description: PubChem standardized value transformed from the value of Ki, IC50, Kd, or EC50. The unit is always micromolar.
